sheet.template: Photorealistic model-agency casting digitals sheet of one single woman, {age} years old, {traits}. Four tall panels side by side in one row, the same woman in every panel, against a plain light-grey studio wall: panel 1 front headshot with a relaxed neutral expression; panel 2 front headshot with a warm genuine smile; panel 3 side profile headshot; panel 4 full-body front view standing naturally. Identical outfit in every panel: fitted plain white t-shirt, straight light-blue jeans, white minimal sneakers, small gold hoop earrings. Hair loose and natural, minimal makeup, soft even daylight, real skin texture, unretouched, consistent identity across panels, professional and tasteful.

villa.template: Full-body photo of the same woman as in the reference sheet: identical face, hair, skin tone and body. She stands at the edge of the infinity pool of a newly built luxury Mediterranean villa at golden hour: white lime walls, travertine deck, olive trees, the sea in the distance. She wears an elegant minimal bikini in plain sand beige with an open sheer white linen shirt over it, small gold hoop earrings, barefoot. She presents the pool to the camera with one open palm, relaxed natural posture, warm genuine smile, looking into the lens. Tasteful, elegant real-estate lifestyle editorial, not sexualized, photorealistic, real skin texture.

door.template: Full-body photo of the same woman as in the reference sheet: identical face, hair, skin tone and body, same outfit (fitted white t-shirt, straight light-blue jeans, white sneakers, small gold hoops). She stands in the open doorway of a newly built Mediterranean villa with a tall light-oak pivot door, white lime facade and a potted olive tree. Her hand farthest from the camera holds the door; her other hand opens toward the bright interior, inviting the viewer in, with a warm genuine smile and eye contact. Natural daylight, photorealistic, real skin texture, premium real-estate film still.
